restriction.android:title: Institution identifier
restriction.android:description: Restrict signed offline content and student backups to this organisation identifier.

restriction.android:title: Enable on-device AI
restriction.android:description: Allow importing and running a local AI model; AI never assigns student marks.

restriction.android:description: Allow students to export their own study backups using the Android document picker.

restriction.android:description: Allow students to import historical study records. Imported records are unverified and cannot boost mastery.
